title: Emberwake
tagline: What is worth keeping, when you cannot keep everything?

act_ends.title: Act I — The Wake
act_ends.subtitle: Saltmarrow remembers you. Mostly.

recap.text: The Gull's Beacon burns on Saltmarrow's lullaby. Nobody there will ever hum it again.
Pell gave the pebble up, and keeps an empty nest clear without knowing why.
The Gull's Beacon burns on the founding knot. Saltmarrow's nets begin in the middle now, and Hesk has stopped humming.
The Gull's Beacon burns on Mara's memory of her brother. She still sets out two cups.
Brother Aldous told you all he could bear to, and cut the ember from his sleeve.
Brother Aldous gave you the bare fact and nothing more.
Mara knows Dunstan walked into the fog by choice.
You carry a message for him: the stool is still by the door.
Oda Farrow remembers a man called Dunstan. The name will not stay with you.
Pell is crossing with you, with Mara's leave, to coil rope on the Slow Mercy.
You promised Pell a crossing, then took it back.
Pell stays on Saltmarrow, and sent a pouch for something lost and good.
Oda Farrow has seen the Keeper's sleeve-ember in your hand.

act_ends.coda: The Slow Mercy sails for Thornwold on the evening tide. Every choice you made here will cross with you.
act_ends.unfinished: Left undone on Saltmarrow for now: %s. The ferry comes back this way.

act_ends.title: Act II — The Drift
act_ends.subtitle: Six lights burn round a dark Spire.

recap.text: The Ridge Light burns on Hob Marl's waiting. He doesn't watch the road for the four any more, and the cold hut is nobody's.
The Ridge Light burns on the salt row. Thornwold's camp will never know who brings its charcoal.
You gave the Lamp its name back: Wynn Sallow.
The Lamp left its name paid in the Book, and stayed the Lamp.
The colliers came up off the far shore with the Lamp's coal for their hearths.
The colliers wait on the Northing's boat-stage for the Spire's boat. You promised to tell the Spire.
The colliers got into Kindleby's skiff, and keep candles on the Keepers' wall now. Ottie looks north from the quay.
The Heron Light burns on Hesper Vail's name. She meets the boats without it.
The Heron Light burns on Corran's knot-cord. Nobody living knows the fen's deep channels.
Dunstan Tollen walked back for his name and rowed home to his stool by Mara's door.
The big man from the rowboat rowed home to Saltmarrow and says he's Mara's brother. She doesn't know him. The second cup is his.
Dunstan Tollen walked back for his name, and stayed on the fen to turn the long walk's boards for whoever comes next.
The big man from the rowboat walked back for his name, and stayed on the fen to turn the long walk's boards.
The Wrack Light burns on Wenna Garrow's answer. Nobody on Wrackholm remembers she ever answered a horn.
The Wrack Light burns on the Gannet's crew board. Her crew are unnamed again on Wrackholm, for good.
The Wrack Light burns on Hale's white-lead pot. Nobody left on Wrackholm has walked the Teeth behind a lampwarden.
You bowed to the Keepers' rite and carried the chapter's choice up the stair.
You told the Provost no, and chose for Kindleby yourself.
The Vigil Light burns on the Boats' Lantern. Nobody on Kindleby remembers how they came over from the Spire.
The Vigil Light burns on Tobin Ashe's coal-pan. He was never called up to the Spire, and will never think to go.
Lowsong's light burns on Iver Lusk's listening. He never heard a voice in the singing, and keeps candles on Kindleby now.
Lowsong's light burns on Iver Lusk's Kindleby. He keeps the rock and listens, and doesn't know there was anywhere else.
Pell sorts Bram's nails at Thornwold's lumber camp.
Pell's lost-things crate has a glass float on top: something lost, something good.
The ember has given back two things of yours: a novice's stair-taper and a bone hood-pin. Someone was counting the landings on the east stair. It was you.
The ember has given back something of yours: a novice's stair-taper, notched for the east stair.

act_ends.coda: The Slow Mercy goes in to Cindermoor on the morning ebb, down a lane no Tidewright has ever sailed. Every light you lit will be burning behind you.
act_ends.unfinished: Still undone on the islands, with a night before the ebb: %s.
